log_file.description: Absolute path to the log file for the Aodh expirer.

log_format.description: Format string for log messages (Python logging format syntax).

log_date_format.description: Date/time format used in log messages.

transport_url.description: Message broker URL for RPC communication (e.g., RabbitMQ or Redis).

database.description: Database configuration section with connection string.

service_credentials.description: OpenStack service credentials for API authentication.

extra_sections.description: Arbitrary additional config sections for site-specific tuning (key = section name, value = dict of key=value pairs).
